title: Systematic Unmeasured Confounder Discovery in Observational Pharmacovigilance: A Large Language Model Framework for Enhanced Causal Inference

contributions.purpose: 提出首个系统化LLM非结构化临床叙事混杂因子发现框架
contributions.mechanism: GPT-4o-mini + 四创新(时序推理防collider/综合临床定义/保守错误处理/多维验证)提取混杂因子
contributions.source_quote: the first systematic framework for automated clinical confounder discovery that addresses the unmeasured confounding limitation constraining observational pharmacovigilance research for decades

contributions.purpose: 临床发现:VPT联合治疗增加AKI风险
contributions.mechanism: IPTW+双稳健+Cox比例风险+E-value敏感性分析
contributions.evaluation: IPTW HR 1.40(95%CI 1.35-1.45),绝对风险差3.8%(每千人38例),E-value 2.15
contributions.domain: 抗生素肾毒性/比较效果研究
contributions.source_quote: VPT combination therapy increases AKI risk by 40% compared to vancomycin monotherapy (HR 1.40, 95% CI: 1.35-1.45)

contributions.purpose: 论证框架提升因果估计精度
contributions.source_quote: Bootstrap analysis with 300 iterations confirmed systematic framework improvement: mean log-HR difference of -0.028 (95% CI: -0.035 to -0.021, p < 0.001)

self_declared_provenance.quote: This is an empirical pharmacovigilance study utilizing established causal inference methodology enhanced through AI automation rather than developing new theoretical frameworks.

notes: 数据/表述红旗:(1)abstract'mean absolute SMD 0.089 vs 0.018'为苹果对橘子——0.089是baseline的pre-IPTW,0.018是post-IPTW;Table2显示LLM-enhanced pre-IPTW SMD实为0.101(比baseline 0.089更差),post-IPTW两者均0.018(0改善);(2)PS AUC 0.56-0.58判别力接近随机却称'improved discrimination';(3)HR 1.40 vs baseline 1.44差异微小、CI重叠,'precision improvement'被夸大为'paradigm shift';(4)checklist引6.2%假阴/2.6%假阳验证率但正文无验证集/金标准;(5)checklist多处数字被截断('98.7...'),显示模板未填全。trade-off:保守错误处理宁可假阴。单中心MIMIC-IV。AI披露:假设/实验设计[C]、分析[B]、写作[C](Claude主笔+Liner peer-review agent+GPT-4o-mini抽取),多AI工具链。
